notes: The wider chassis trades the former 180 mm folded-width target for room around the specified camera.
No new head actuator, separate camera pod or extra printed body trim.
Envelopes are not purchased components and do not establish an electrical BOM or final mass.
Passage sizes reserve space; wire gauge/insulation, current heating and bend radius must be selected together.
Shin passage requires a flat harness. Feed unterminated wires before fitting connectors.
Printed static channels are integrated in the existing thigh frame and shin case; no extra cable-cover prints.
The viewer's orange and blue flexible paths are sketches, not collision-checked constant-length cables.
Grommets, strain relief, sealing, joint-loop retention and motor lead termination remain unfinished.

limitations: Hip drivetrains, grounded tie-pin supports, joint retainers and pivot hardware remain unfinished.
Wheel modules are detailed but load, tolerance, print-support and manufacturing checks remain open.
Camera, Pi, battery and control electronics have explicit space allocations; detailed mounts, cooling, connectors and wiring flex remain unverified.
The roomy D435i body widens the assembly; the previous 180 mm folded-width target is not met.
Wheel phase shown follows the shin; collision checking must cover all wheel angles separately.
No R2 motion evidence transfers to this V2 assembly. No complete mass has been assigned.
Not a BOM, sliced mass or measured prototype. Current asymmetry is retained; right output hardware remains incomplete.
Full-density print assumption can overestimate infilled print mass; omitted hardware can underestimate total mass.
Motor subdivisions normalized to complete motor masses; relative rotor and intermediate spin must be added by the plant.
Purchased bearings assigned to carrier bodies; race-relative inertia omitted. Coil spring mass split between seats.
Controller, battery, computer/cooling, camera and missing hardware allowances are priors, not verified part selections.
